source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 14 (PDF 264-296), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 14 (Vectors in Space) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Let \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{w} = 3\underline{i} + \underline{k}\). Find (i) \(|2\underline{u} - \underline{v} + \underline{w}|\) (ii) a unit vector parallel to \(\underline{u} + \underline{v} + \underline{w}\). (5 marks)
(\(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = 3\underline{i} + \underline{k}\) hon to (i) \(|2\underline{u} - \underline{v} + \underline{w}|\) (ii) \(\underline{u} + \underline{v} + \underline{w}\) ke parallel unit vector nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle har vector component by component banayein, phir magnitude lein; unit vector = vector taqseem us ki magnitude.

book_ref.quote: We define the magnitude, norm, or length of a vector

blocks.prompt:
2 Prove that \(a(\underline{v} + \underline{w}) = a\underline{v} + a\underline{w}\) for any vectors \(\underline{v}, \underline{w}\) in \(R^{3}\) and \(a \in R\). Verify it for \(a = 3\), \(\underline{v} = [1, -2, 4]\), \(\underline{w} = [2, 0, -1]\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(R^{3}\) ke vectors \(\underline{v}, \underline{w}\) aur \(a \in R\) ke liye \(a(\underline{v} + \underline{w}) = a\underline{v} + a\underline{w}\). Phir \(a = 3\), \(\underline{v} = [1, -2, 4]\), \(\underline{w} = [2, 0, -1]\) ke liye tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Vectors ko components mein likhein aur har component mein real numbers ka distributive law lagayein.

book_ref.quote: The proofs of the other parts are left as an exercise for the students.

steps: \(\underline{v} = [x', y', z']\), \(\underline{w} = [x'', y'', z'']\); \(a(\underline{v} + \underline{w}) = a[x' + x'',\ y' + y'',\ z' + z'']\)
\(= [ax' + ax'',\ ay' + ay'',\ az' + az'']\) (real numbers ka qanoon \(a(p + q) = ap + aq\))
\(= [ax', ay', az'] + [ax'', ay'', az''] = a\underline{v} + a\underline{w}\)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(a(\underline{v} + \underline{w}) = a\underline{v} + a\underline{w}\); diye gaye data ke liye dono taraf \([9, -6, 9]\).

blocks.prompt:
3 Prove that the direction cosines of a non-zero vector satisfy \(\cos^{2}\alpha + \cos^{2}\beta + \cos^{2}\gamma = 1\). Find the direction cosines of \(\overrightarrow{PQ}\) for \(P(2, -1, 3)\), \(Q(4, 1, 2)\) and verify the result. (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke non-zero vector ke direction cosines ke liye \(\cos^{2}\alpha + \cos^{2}\beta + \cos^{2}\gamma = 1\). Phir \(P(2, -1, 3)\), \(Q(4, 1, 2)\) ke liye \(\overrightarrow{PQ}\) ke direction cosines nikal kar tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Right triangles OAP, OBP, OCP se har cosine = component taqseem length.

book_ref.quote: Prove that \(\cos^{2}\alpha + \cos^{2}\beta + \cos^{2}\gamma = 1\).

blocks.prompt:
4 Show that the projection of \(\underline{v}\) along \(\underline{u}\) is \(\dfrac{\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}}{|\underline{u}|}\). Hence find the projection of \(\underline{v} = 3\underline{i} - 6\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\) along \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\) and of \(\underline{u}\) along \(\underline{v}\). (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(\underline{v}\) ka \(\underline{u}\) ke saath projection \(\dfrac{\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}}{|\underline{u}|}\) hai. Phir \(\underline{v} = 3\underline{i} - 6\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\) ka \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\) par aur \(\underline{u}\) ka \(\underline{v}\) par projection nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\underline{v}\) ki nok se \(\underline{u}\) par amood girayein; OM = |v| cos θ, phir cos θ dot product se rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Then \(\overline{OM}\) is called the projection of

blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua. Yahan \(-\frac{4}{3}\) aur \(-\frac{4}{7}\) (angle obtuse hai is liye negative).

blocks.prompt:
5 Prove that \((\underline{u} + \underline{v}) \cdot (\underline{u} - \underline{v}) = |\underline{u}|^{2} - |\underline{v}|^{2}\). Deduce that the diagonals of a rhombus are perpendicular. (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \((\underline{u} + \underline{v}) \cdot (\underline{u} - \underline{v}) = |\underline{u}|^{2} - |\underline{v}|^{2}\). Is se saabit karein ke rhombus ke diagonals perpendicular hote hain.)
blocks.explanation: Distributive aur commutative properties se kholein; rhombus mein adjacent sides \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\) barabar lambi hain aur diagonals \(\underline{u} + \underline{v}\), \(\underline{u} - \underline{v}\) hain.

book_ref.quote: be vectors and let \(c\) be any real number, then

steps: Dot product \(= 0\) aur diagonals non-zero hain, is liye perpendicular
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua; rhombus ke diagonals aik doosre par amood hain.

blocks.prompt:
6 If \(\underline{u} = a_{1}\underline{i} + b_{1}\underline{j} + c_{1}\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{v} = a_{2}\underline{i} + b_{2}\underline{j} + c_{2}\underline{k}\), prove that \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v} = a_{1}a_{2} + b_{1}b_{2} + c_{1}c_{2}\). Use it to find \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}\) for \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} - 5\underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = 3\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 4\underline{k}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v} = a_{1}a_{2} + b_{1}b_{2} + c_{1}c_{2}\). Phir \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} - 5\underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = 3\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 4\underline{k}\) ke liye \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Distributive law se nau terms banayein aur unit vectors ke dot products lagayein.

book_ref.quote: From distributive law we can write:

steps: Distributive law se nau terms: \(a_{1}a_{2}(\underline{i} \cdot \underline{i}) + a_{1}b_{2}(\underline{i} \cdot \underline{j}) + \dots + c_{1}c_{2}(\underline{k} \cdot \underline{k})\)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua; diye gaye vectors ke liye \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v} = -3\).

blocks.prompt:
7 Let \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + \alpha\underline{j} + \underline{k}\) and \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\). (i) Find \(\alpha\) so that \(\underline{u}\) and \(\underline{v}\) are perpendicular. (ii) For \(\alpha = 1\), find the angle between \(\underline{u}\) and \(\underline{v}\). (5 marks)
(\(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + \alpha\underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\). (i) \(\alpha\) nikalein taake dono perpendicular hon. (ii) \(\alpha = 1\) par darmiyani angle nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Perpendicular ka matlab dot product zero; angle \(\cos\theta = \frac{\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v}}{|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|}\) se.

book_ref.quote: The angle between two vectors \(\underline{u}\) and \(\underline{v}\) is determined from the definition of dot product

blocks.prompt:
8 Show that the points \(A(1, 0, 2)\), \(B(3, 1, 1)\) and \(C(2, -1, 3)\) are the vertices of a right triangle. Find its area. (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke points \(A(1, 0, 2)\), \(B(3, 1, 1)\), \(C(2, -1, 3)\) right triangle ke vertices hain. Is ka area nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Sides ke vectors nikalein; jis vertex par dot product zero ho wahan right angle hai; Pythagoras se tasdeeq karein.

book_ref.quote: The angle between two vectors \(\underline{u}\) and \(\underline{v}\) is determined from the definition of dot product

blocks.final_answer: \(A\) par right angle; area \(\frac{3\sqrt{2}}{2}\) square units.

blocks.prompt:
9 Constant forces \(\underline{F}_{1} = 3\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{F}_{2} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\) act on a particle that is displaced from \(A(1, -2, 3)\) to \(B(4, 1, 5)\). Find the total work done. (5 marks)
(Constant forces \(\underline{F}_{1} = 3\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\) aur \(\underline{F}_{2} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\) aik particle ko \(A(1, -2, 3)\) se \(B(4, 1, 5)\) tak le jati hain. Kul work done nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Forces jama kar ke resultant, phir displacement AB, phir W = F · d.

book_ref.quote: In figure, a constant force

blocks.prompt:
10 A force of magnitude 9 units acts in the direction of \(2\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + \underline{k}\) and moves its point of application from \(P(1, 2, 0)\) to \(Q(4, 0, 2)\). Find the work done. (5 marks)
(9 units magnitude ki force \(2\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + \underline{k}\) ki simt mein lag kar point ko \(P(1, 2, 0)\) se \(Q(4, 0, 2)\) tak le jati hai. Work done nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle force vector = 9 zarb di gayi simt ka unit vector; phir displacement se dot product.

book_ref.quote: the work done by \(\underline{F}\) is defined to be the product of the component of

blocks.prompt:
11 If \(\underline{u} = a_1\underline{i} + b_1\underline{j} + c_1\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{v} = a_2\underline{i} + b_2\underline{j} + c_2\underline{k}\), derive the determinant formula \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ a_1 & b_1 & c_1 \\ a_2 & b_2 & c_2 \end{vmatrix}\). (5 marks)
(\(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) ka determinant formula derive karein.)
blocks.explanation: Distributive property se kholein aur unit vectors ke cross products ki qeematein rakhein.

book_ref.quote: which is known as determinant formula for

steps: \(= a_1b_2\underline{k} - a_1c_2\underline{j} - b_1a_2\underline{k} + b_1c_2\underline{i} + c_1a_2\underline{j} - c_1b_2\underline{i}\)
Yahi determinant ki pehli row se expansion hai
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ a_1 & b_1 & c_1 \\ a_2 & b_2 & c_2 \end{vmatrix}\).

blocks.prompt:
12 For \(\underline{a} = 3\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{b} = \underline{i} - \underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\), find \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) and \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\), show that \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) is perpendicular to both \(\underline{a}\) and \(\underline{b}\), and find a unit vector perpendicular to both and the sine of the angle between \(\underline{a}\) and \(\underline{b}\). (5 marks)
(\(\underline{a} = 3\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\), \(\underline{b} = \underline{i} - \underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\) ke liye \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\), \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\) nikalein, dikhayein ke \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) dono par perpendicular hai, aur dono par amood unit vector aur darmiyani angle ka sine nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Determinant formula lagayein; perpendicular ki tasdeeq do dot products se; sine = |a × b|/(|a||b|).

book_ref.quote: is determined from the definition of cross product.

blocks.prompt:
13 Prove that \(|\underline{u} \times \underline{v}|^{2} + (\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v})^{2} = |\underline{u}|^{2}|\underline{v}|^{2}\). Verify it for \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + \underline{j}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{j} + \underline{k}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(|\underline{u} \times \underline{v}|^{2} + (\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v})^{2} = |\underline{u}|^{2}|\underline{v}|^{2}\). \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + \underline{j}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{j} + \underline{k}\) ke liye tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono products aik hi angle mein likhein aur sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 lagayein.

book_ref.quote: is determined from the definition of cross product.

blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua; diye gaye vectors ke liye \(3 + 1 = 4\).

blocks.prompt:
14 Find the area of the triangle with vertices \(A(2, 1, 0)\), \(B(3, -1, 2)\) and \(C(0, 2, 1)\), and a unit vector perpendicular to its plane. (5 marks)
(Triangle \(A(2, 1, 0)\), \(B(3, -1, 2)\), \(C(0, 2, 1)\) ka area aur is ke plane par amood unit vector nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik vertex se do sides lein; un ke cross product ki aadhi magnitude area hai; cross product taqseem magnitude unit normal hai.

book_ref.quote: are vectors along two adjacent sides of the triangle.

blocks.prompt:
15 Show that \(A(1, 0, 1)\), \(B(2, 2, 1)\), \(C(4, 3, 3)\), \(D(3, 1, 3)\) are the vertices of a parallelogram \(ABCD\) and find its area. (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(A(1, 0, 1)\), \(B(2, 2, 1)\), \(C(4, 3, 3)\), \(D(3, 1, 3)\) parallelogram \(ABCD\) ke vertices hain aur is ka area nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Opposite sides vector ke tor par barabar hon to parallelogram; area = adjacent sides ke cross product ki magnitude.

book_ref.quote: represent the length of the adjacent sides of a parallelogram

blocks.prompt:
16 Find the moment about the point \(M(1, 1, 1)\) of the force represented by \(\underline{AB}\), where \(A(2, 0, 1)\) and \(B(3, 2, -1)\). Also find the magnitude of the moment. (5 marks)
(\(\underline{AB}\) se zahir force ka point \(M(1, 1, 1)\) ke gird moment nikalein, jahan \(A(2, 0, 1)\), \(B(3, 2, -1)\). Moment ki magnitude bhi nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Force A par lagti hai, is liye r = MA aur moment = r × F.

blocks.prompt:
17 Show that \((\underline{u} \times \underline{v}) \cdot \underline{w}\) is the volume of the parallelepiped with conterminous edges \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\), \(\underline{w}\), and that \((\underline{u} \times \underline{v}) \cdot \underline{w} = (\underline{v} \times \underline{w}) \cdot \underline{u} = (\underline{w} \times \underline{u}) \cdot \underline{v}\). (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \((\underline{u} \times \underline{v}) \cdot \underline{w}\) us parallelepiped ka volume hai jis ke conterminous edges (aik nuqte se nikalne wale kinare) \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\), \(\underline{w}\) hain, aur \((\underline{u} \times \underline{v}) \cdot \underline{w} = (\underline{v} \times \underline{w}) \cdot \underline{u} = (\underline{w} \times \underline{u}) \cdot \underline{v}\).)
blocks.explanation: Volume = base ka area × height; base area |u × v| aur height w ka u × v ki simt mein component.

book_ref.quote: represents the volume of the parallelepiped having

steps: Is liye \((\underline{u} \times \underline{v}) \cdot \underline{w}\) = base area × height = volume

Base \(\underline{v}, \underline{w}\) ya \(\underline{w}, \underline{u}\) par lene se wohi volume: \((\underline{v} \times \underline{w}) \cdot \underline{u}\), \((\underline{w} \times \underline{u}) \cdot \underline{v}\)

blocks.prompt:
18 A parallelepiped is determined by \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{j} + \underline{k}\) and \(\underline{w} = 2\underline{i} + \underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\). Find its volume, and its height when the base is formed by \(\underline{u}\) and \(\underline{v}\). (5 marks)
(Parallelepiped \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = 2\underline{i} + \underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\) se bana hai. Volume nikalein, aur height jab base \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\) se bana ho.)
blocks.explanation: Volume = |(u × v) · w|, base area = |u × v|; height = volume ÷ base area.

book_ref.quote: represents the volume of the parallelepiped having

blocks.prompt:
19 Show that the volume of the tetrahedron \(ABCD\) with \(\underline{u} = \underline{AB}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{AC}\), \(\underline{w} = \underline{AD}\) is \(\frac{1}{6}[\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\). Find the volume of the tetrahedron with vertices \(A(1, 1, 1)\), \(B(2, 1, 3)\), \(C(3, 2, 1)\), \(D(1, 4, 2)\). (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke tetrahedron \(ABCD\) ka volume \(\frac{1}{6}[\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\) hai. Phir \(A(1, 1, 1)\), \(B(2, 1, 3)\), \(C(3, 2, 1)\), \(D(1, 4, 2)\) wale tetrahedron ka volume nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Volume = 1/3 (base triangle ka area)(height); triangle parallelogram ka aadha hai.

book_ref.quote: Volume of the tetrahedron

blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua; yahan volume \(\frac{13}{6}\) cubic units.

blocks.prompt:
20 For \(\underline{u} = a_1\underline{i} + b_1\underline{j} + c_1\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = a_2\underline{i} + b_2\underline{j} + c_2\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = a_3\underline{i} + b_3\underline{j} + c_3\underline{k}\), prove that \(\underline{u} \cdot (\underline{v} \times \underline{w}) = \begin{vmatrix} a_1 & b_1 & c_1 \\ a_2 & b_2 & c_2 \\ a_3 & b_3 & c_3 \end{vmatrix}\). Evaluate it for \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} - 3\underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = 3\underline{i} + \underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\). (5 marks)
(Scalar triple product ka determinant formula saabit karein, phir \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} - 3\underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = 3\underline{i} + \underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\) ke liye qeemat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle v × w determinant formula se, phir u se dot; jawab 3×3 determinant ki pehli row se expansion hai.

book_ref.quote: Which is called the determinant formula for scalar triple product of

steps: \(\underline{u} \cdot (\underline{v} \times \underline{w}) = a_1(b_2c_3 - b_3c_2) - b_1(a_2c_3 - a_3c_2) + c_1(a_2b_3 - a_3b_2)\)
Yahi determinant ki pehli row se expansion hai
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua; diye gaye vectors ke liye qeemat 20.

blocks.prompt:
21 Prove that the points \(A(1, 0, 2)\), \(B(2, 1, 3)\), \(C(3, 0, 1)\) and \(D(1, 2, 5)\) are coplanar. (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke points \(A(1, 0, 2)\), \(B(2, 1, 3)\), \(C(3, 0, 1)\), \(D(1, 2, 5)\) coplanar hain.)
blocks.explanation: Chaar points tab coplanar hain jab AB, AC, AD coplanar hon, yani scalar triple product zero ho.

book_ref.quote: Vectors are coplanar if they lie in the same plane

steps: Triple product zero, is liye vectors coplanar

blocks.prompt:
22 Let \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \alpha\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} + \underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = 3\underline{i} + 2\underline{k}\). (i) Find \(\alpha\) so that the vectors are coplanar. (ii) For \(\alpha = 2\), find the volume of the parallelepiped with edges \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\), \(\underline{w}\). (5 marks)
(\(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \alpha\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} + \underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = 3\underline{i} + 2\underline{k}\). (i) \(\alpha\) nikalein taake vectors coplanar hon. (ii) \(\alpha = 2\) par parallelepiped ka volume nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Coplanar ke liye triple product zero; volume us ki absolute qeemat.

book_ref.quote: Vectors are coplanar if they lie in the same plane

blocks.prompt:
23 Prove that \([\underline{u} + \underline{v}\ \ \underline{v}\ \ \underline{w}] = [\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\) for any vectors \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\), \(\underline{w}\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke kisi bhi vectors ke liye \([\underline{u} + \underline{v}\ \ \underline{v}\ \ \underline{w}] = [\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\).)
blocks.explanation: Triple product ko v × w ke saath dot product likhein, distributive law lagayein; do barabar vectors wala triple product zero hai.

book_ref.quote: If any two vectors of scalar triple product are equal

blocks.prompt:
24 A force \(\underline{F} = [10, -20, 5]\) N is applied at the point \(P(3, 1, -2)\). Find the torque about the pivot \(M(1, 0, 1)\) and its magnitude (distances in metres). (5 marks)
(Force \(\underline{F} = [10, -20, 5]\) N point \(P(3, 1, -2)\) par lagti hai. Pivot \(M(1, 0, 1)\) ke gird torque aur us ki magnitude nikalein (faasle metre mein).)
blocks.explanation: M ke gird torque = r × F, jahan r = M se P tak ka vector.

book_ref.quote: Determine the torque produced by this force about the pivot point.
